# Generative state-space Boolean authority

`boolean-ato.mjs` is a byte-identical copy of the user's existing source:

- Repository: https://github.com/justappgrabbin/Generative-address-system
- Commit: `ce1704d5d53d5729b499463f7eeaf5dcd5091550`
- Path: `Synthia-Generative-Address-Morphology-Integrated-v0.2.1-RUNNABLE/authorities/execution-spine/src/pure-synthia/engine/boolean-ato.js`
- Git blob SHA-1: `1d4e128f8e9139e386518e77c4fa6a752f62ea5b`

Its sixteen binary functions and aliases supply Codex3's Boolean operations. The bridge validates strict Boolean arrays and passes them without reversing line order. It accepts only own catalog names/aliases, rejecting inherited object-property names. Six-bit integer conversion remains explicitly line-zero-first in the compiler. No assertion is made that all sixteen functions support Klein's involution-based analogy identities; that property must be checked per function.

This imports the Boolean algebra, not the entire addressed semantic authority, state-space grammar, Neural Net Maker, Foundry, scene construction or generative-world system. Those integrations must be verified separately. The source file is unmodified; unused methods using Array.at are not invoked by the embedded binary-operation bridge.

## Fragment meaning layer (added 2026-11-13)

`constants.js`, `addressing.js` and `fragments.js` are byte-identical copies from the same commit `ce1704d5d53d5729b499463f7eeaf5dcd5091550`, path `.../src/pure-synthia/state-space/`:

- constants.js — blob `5535737f372822f138160ccbaf510d0535b0cb39`
- addressing.js — blob `c01af6238abd9a9792726eedffb67c5649aae7d2`
- fragments.js — blob `2617074df137a12cdb27d1a13bf17e11c0808e19`

`core/address-swarm-bridge.js` uses them to give each 3-2-1 body its meaning: two-line packs use `SI_XIANG`, trigrams use `TRIGRAM_MATRIX`, both page-cited in the source. A test checks that `addressing.js` gate bits match Codex3's rule-derived wheel on all 64 gates; they agree. The source files are unmodified. The rest of the Generative state space (grammar, chains, Human Design tables, mesh) is not imported here.
